title.narrative: UNDESA - Providing Strategic Support on Financing Issues

description.narrative:
The planned effect on society (Impact) is:
• Deliver a more inclusive, equitable, and effective international tax system aligned with sustainable development (Impact 1). • Strengthen the capacity of developing countries for domestic public resource mobilization (Impact 2). • Facilitate national economic and financial systems that mobilize resources for sustainable development and foster systemic reforms in the international financial and economic architecture (Impact 3).
3. The planned effects for the target group (Outcome) are:
• Outcome 1.1: Establish a universal, inclusive platform for international tax cooperation and governance, with norms better adapted to developing country needs and supporting domestic resource mobilization. • Outcome 1.2: The UN Tax Committee is better equipped to enhance international tax cooperation and deliver policy and practical guidance responsive to developing country priorities. • Outcome 1.3: Effective participation of developing countries and inputs by their expert staff contribute to a Framework Convention aligned with their needs, priorities, and capacities. • Outcome 2.1: Meaningful engagement and informed participation of LDCs, LLDCs, and SIDS in international tax cooperation fora lead to norms better suited to developing country needs. • Outcome 2.2: Assisted developing countries develop/enhance efficient and effective tax systems that support national priorities and increase domestic resource mobilization aligned with the SDGs. • Outcome 3: Delegates and officials have a strong evidence base for international policy commitments and norm setting on financing topics. • Outcome 4.1: Enhanced intergovernmental and multistakeholder engagement with FfD at global, regional, and national levels leads to more coherent follow-up to the Sevilla Commitment. • Outcome 4.2: National-level coordination and capacity to implement the Sevilla Commitment are strengthened; coherence among ministries and partners improves for e
